scope: prove ring-B delivery and correct the gamestate header width

ring_b_counters.meaning: 13 datagrams from our server were written into ring B and the client consumed all of them - delivery is no longer in question

gamestate_header_now_correct_width.why: 2697 SV_SendClientGameState writes MSG_WriteByte(svc_EOF=7), MSG_WriteLong(0), then MSG_WriteLong(svc_gamestate=1) - svc_gamestate is a LONG, not a byte; the earlier single 0x01 was the wrong width
gamestate_header_now_correct_width.still_no_ack: client messageAck stayed 1 for all seq 6..8

conclusion.transport_chain_complete: bridge -> ring B -> client consumption is proven by the equal read/write counters
conclusion.remaining_problem_is_purely_the_payload: the client reads our packets but does not acknowledge, so the body is still not a usable gamestate
